title: Remapping Browser Search Key (MS Natural Keyboard 4000) to Ctrl + F opens "Project" Panel
author: TheSimArchitect
summary: A remapped Microsoft keyboard search/media key sends the configured output and its original hardware command.

confidence.rationale: Dual dispatch is clear, but the bypassing event source may be driver-specific.

judgment.rationale: Dual dispatch is reproducible, but hardware tracing must identify the original path.
evidence: Reporter and collaborator observed both actions.
Browser Search and Browser Home style keys are affected.
The behavior spans two Microsoft keyboard models.

fix_assessment.rationale: No concrete existing fix covers the reported path; the lightweight hypothesis is ready for a bounded design workflow.

inferences: A parallel HID consumer-control or vendor path bypasses keyboard-event suppression.

actions.label: Approve special-key suppression investigation

verification: Map the key to Ctrl+F and confirm only Find executes.
